notes:
- Translate: new "Gemini Router" – every key and every fast Gemini model the keys have, in turn; a key or model that is used up hands over by itself. The live window (🔑 in Batch) shows each key at work.
- Gemini keys: a refused key is taken out (also after a restart), a key that used today's quota waits for Google's daily reset, and when every key is used up Google Translate (free) finishes the lines – or the work stops and tells you (Settings › Gemini).
- "Get a free key": the steps to a free Google AI Studio key – a key copied there is tested and saved by itself, no pasting.
- AI check after every Transcribe: lines to check that are right lose their mark, small mistakes are fixed, noise is taken out – "Use the AI's words" and "All right" do the rest in one click, and the result is shown.
- Characters: Rank (king, royal family, official, servant, monk …) – Gemini uses the right Khmer words of address (រាជសព្ទ, ទូលបង្គំ, ខ្ញុំម្ចាស់, អាត្មា). Auto: the AI tells it, and the next episodes keep it.
- Glossary › Read aloud: how the voice says a word (VIP → វីអាយភី) – the subtitle keeps it as written.
- Batch: a Telegram message on your phone for each finished or failed episode and at the end of the queue (your own bot).
- Khmer translation: Thai, Chinese or English words left in a line ("seat", "เมื่อ") are asked again – the voice no longer reads foreign words.
- Batch with Fun-ASR-Nano on a small graphics card runs one video at a time (two waited for each other), and the story glossary no longer learns names in Latin letters.
